title: Verify, request the exact human action, then resume
when: A declared site is signed out or an exploratory mission hits auth
need: Verify first; authorize opens only expired sites. Human supplies personal credentials; unreachable probes need technical repair. Sign-in pauses automated browsers on that machine until windows close. From the connected workstation, --machine reads declarations and opens sign-in on the registered Test Machine GUI, without a control-plane connection there. Unrouted hosts still receive nonsecret declarations locally; live identity store survives reset. Required desktop-browser extension: browser authorize must also check Test Machine Linux Chromium and macOS Safari sign-ins, open only expired sites, name the account, and keep desktop sign-ins live through reset outside goldens. The unmerged source candidate implements this extension; full CI, merge, real-host and release proof remain pending. Existing automation identity behavior is separate.
surface: Installed browser identities reference and authorize help; successor Pack Linux procedure and macOS entry pointer to the complete browser-identities procedure.
gap: The unreleased successor repairs the portable installed reference and per-OS private-policy audience boundary in source. Released-target and actual receiving/sign-in proof remain pending. The desktop-browser extension now has unmerged source evidence; full CI, merge and real-host/released proof remain pending.
review: Remote command, lease ownership, settings validation, quoting, OS GUI helpers and post-window outcome forwarding have source regression tests; live operator sign-in proof remains pending. Source-only successor documentation preserves all six macOS identity steps in browser-identities.md and keeps a mandatory macOS entry link. The unmerged Linux reset correction 5a4b84c0d7565f38cc2308df25950fd76d4fef0e has producer-reported 29 targeted PASS and CI run 39040788218 PASS, QA requirement 50631 artifact 36759; no real reset or released delivery is proved. Unmerged authorize successor 31b0cfaf30d303c729d936d49e178fa65e6faeed atop that reset correction is source-observed: --machine checks the selected automation identity then native Linux snap Chromium or macOS Safari in one remote GUI command, with declared sites/accounts, headless native-cookie checks, expired-only tabs, unreadable/unreachable refusals, desktop reset refusal and Chromium last-used profile selection. Producer reports 53 focused authorization checks and ruff PASS; full CI requirement 44643 is still running. Merge, real-host sign-in/reset and released delivery remain pending.
